text: Tim Merlier claimed his third stage win of the Tour with a masterclass in sprint positioning, threading through chaos as Fernando Gaviria and Søren Wærenskjold went down hard in the final kilometers—a crash that claimed half a dozen riders and nearly derailed Jasper Philipsen before officials sorted out the carnage. Tadej Pogačar steered clear of the wreckage to protect his three-minute cushion over Vingegaard, keeping the GC stable on a day when the sprinters finally got their stage and the peloton got a reminder that flat terrain can be just as treacherous as the mountains.
